schema.limitation: Serialization schema only; does not implement appearance texture loading or animation.

operation: Independently combine original region/mesh/point/bounding/clipping attachment identity, geometry and source data scale. Preserve original mesh triangle indices, UVs, trim/rotation, source weights and typed non-rendering attachments; bounding geometry connects to the migrated clipping interface. Real body atlas and dye texture are resolved APK-first through current original placeholder mappings and AssetTable GUIDs, decoded mip-by-mip without re-compression and retain native samplers/color space. No skeleton SDK implementation or baked actor prefab is used.
validated_scope: Unity 2022.3.57f1c2 isolated Play Mode passed all 34009 original attachments, 254385 scaled vertices/points and 635730 exact triangle indices. Maximum coordinate difference 3.81469727E-06 within 0.000005 + 0.000007 * abs(expected), maximum UV difference 5.96046448E-08 within 0.000002. Original bounding/clip/point types and explicit source data scale pass. Real original main/dye textures have separate hash-verified artifacts; D3D11 raster has 25719 visible and 22359 colored pixels, zero pixels differing from independently computed reference geometry by more than 2 channel levels. Runtime image inspected. Geometry matrices are synthetic, not official constrained poses; complete character/page rendering is not validated.
limitations: Production skeleton state, world constraints, clipping triangulation, material batches and actor/page integration remain required.
